module_step.title: Create Title Classifier watcher
module_step.description: Explicitly choose which entity is watched and which axes (media type, context, signal type) apply. Nothing is guessed from entity names.

data.name: Watcher name
data.context: Context (homepod / pc / ps5 / switch / stash / apple_tv)
data.source_app: Source app (optional, e.g. Netflix / Plex / Jellyfin)
data.inactive_values: Extra inactive values, comma-separated (e.g. "No Game, Paused")
data.scope: Scope (same value on both instances = shared)
data.retention_days: How long should old entries be kept?

db.title: Media catalog database (hub)
db.description: One-time connection to the shared Postgres database (LXC 108). Stored as a central "Title Classifier DB" entry that all watchers use; later changes are made only here.

artist.title: Select artist attribute
artist.description: Optional: choose the attribute that provides artist, author, or station name. If it does not fit, the integration falls back to known media attributes.

reconfigure.title: Reconfigure
reconfigure.description: For the DB hub, update the connection (applies to all watchers); for a watcher, its watched source entity and axes. The name and entry_id are kept.

data.context: Context (homepod / pc / ps5 / switch / stash / apple_tv)
data.scope: Scope (same value on both instances = shared)

data.auto_hide_hours: Automatically hide unclassified entries after hours (0 = off)

user.title: Add watcher
user.description: Add a watcher as a nested device under the hub. Explicitly choose the watched entity and its axes; nothing is guessed from entity names.

data.name: Watcher name
data.context: Context (homepod / pc / ps5 / switch / stash / apple_tv)
data.source_app: Source app (optional, e.g. Netflix / Plex / Jellyfin)
data.inactive_values: Extra inactive values, comma-separated (e.g. "No Game, Paused")
data.scope: Scope (same value on both instances = shared)
data.retention_days: How long should old entries be kept?

reconfigure.title: Reconfigure watcher
reconfigure.description: Update this watcher's watched source entity and axes. The name stays fixed (it defines the entity IDs).

data.context: Context (homepod / pc / ps5 / switch / stash / apple_tv)
data.scope: Scope (same value on both instances = shared)
data.retention_days: How long should old entries be kept?

error.name_taken: A watcher with this name already exists. Choose a unique name (e.g. Stash Slot 1).
